messages.subject: Replicating Server.R thetas_history without Shiny
parts:
I am tasked with replicating  mirtCAT session results in a non-shiny (dull?) environment.   In particular, I need the same person$thetas_history.

The original shiny session is run with:

shiningPath <- function() {
  GUI = list(title = "Shiny Survey",
             authors = "", stem_default_format = shiny::h5,
             lastpage = function(person){return(list(h5("Thanks for taking the survey. 
                                                      To exit, please click the action button")))},
             time_before_answer = 3
  )
  mirtCAT(.design.df, .design.mo, 
          preCAT = .design.preCAT,
          design = list(min_SEM=0.5),
          start_item = 'Trule',
          shinyGUI = GUI)
}

Using the same .design.* values, I attempt to construct the same final state given the same questions and answers.  The thetas_history is close, but diverges slightly after even one answer

buildMirtCatStateObject <- function(questions, answers) {
  CATdesign <- mirtCAT(.design.df, .design.mo, 
                       preCAT = .design.preCAT,
                       design = list(min_SEM=0.5),
                       start_item = 'Trule',
                       design_elements = TRUE)
  if (is.null(questions)) {
    return(CATdesign)
  }
  for (i in c(1:length(questions))) {
    # this just updates items_answered, responses, etc.
    CATdesign <- updateDesign(CATdesign, items=questions[i], responses=answers[i])
    
    # from Server.R#166...
    CATdesign$des...@Update.thetas(design=CATdesign$design, person=CATdesign$person, test=CATdesign$test)
    CATdesign$person$Update.info_mats(design=CATdesign$design, test=CATdesign$test)
    #CATdesign$design <- update.stop_now(CATdesign$design, person=CATdesign$person)
  }
  CATdesign
}

I'm am an experienced software developer, but R confounds me.  

What am I doing wrong? How can I compare the S4 state objects that are inputs to the update functions?
